igbo: Onye ọrụ ugbo gara n'ubi.
english: The farmer went to the farm.

igbo: Ha kụrụ ọka.
Mmiri ozuzo dara nke ọma.
A na-akụ ji n'oge opupu ihe ubi.
english: Yam is planted during the planting season.

igbo: Onye ọrụ ugbo na-akụ mkpụrụ.
Ndị ọrụ ugbo na-arụ ọrụ n'ubi.
english: The farmers work on the farm.

igbo: Ọka toro nke ọma.
Ji ahụ buru ibu.
Anyị kụrụ osikapa n'ubi.
english: We planted rice on the farm.

igbo: Ọrụ ugbo bụ ọrụ dị mkpa.
Onye ọrụ ugbo na-eji hoe arụ ọrụ.
english: The farmer uses a hoe to work.

igbo: Ọ na-agba mmiri n'ubi.
Ha na-akụ akwụkwọ nri.
Akwụkwọ nri ahụ dị ọhụrụ.
Onye ọrụ ugbo zụtara mkpụrụ ọka.
Anyị ga-akụ ihe ọkụkụ echi.
Anụ ụlọ chọrọ nri.
Ọzụzụ anụ ụlọ na-eweta ego.
Onye ọrụ ugbo na-azụ ehi.
Ha nwere ọtụtụ ọkụkọ.
Ọkụkọ ahụ tọrọ akwa.
Ehi ahụ na-enye mmiri ara.
Onye ọrụ ugbo na-azụ ewu.
Ewu ahụ riri ahịhịa.
Ha na-elekọta anụ ụlọ nke ọma.
english: They take good care of the livestock.

igbo: Ọrụ ugbo chọrọ ndidi.
Onye ọrụ ugbo na-arụsi ọrụ ike.
Anyị gara ịtụ ihe ubi.
english: We went to harvest the crops.

igbo: Ha na-ewe ihe ubi n'oge.
english: They harvest the crops on time.

igbo: Owuwe ihe ubi malitere.
Ọka dị njikere maka owuwe ihe ubi.
english: The maize is ready for harvest.

igbo: Ha kpọkọtara ihe ubi.
Onye ọrụ ugbo rere ihe ubi ya.
Ahịa ihe ubi dị mma taa.
english: The market for farm produce is good today.

igbo: Ọnụ ahịa ọka mụbara.
Ọnụ ahịa ji dara.
Ha rere akwụkwọ nri n'ahịa.
english: They sold vegetables at the market.

igbo: Onye ahịa zụtara akpa osikapa.
english: The customer bought a bag of rice.

igbo: Akpa ọka ahụ dị arọ.
english: That bag of maize is heavy.

igbo: Anyị chọrọ ịzụtakwu nri.
english: We want to buy more food.

igbo: Mmiri dị mkpa maka ihe ọkụkụ.
Osisi chọrọ ìhè anyanwụ.
Ahịhịa na-eto ngwa ngwa.
Ha wepụrụ ahịhịa n'ubi.
english: They removed weeds from the farm.

igbo: Ahịhịa na-emebi ihe ọkụkụ.
Onye ọrụ ugbo na-asacha ubi.
Ha ji fatịlaịza mee ka ala dị mma.
english: They used fertilizer to improve the soil.

igbo: Ala a dị mma maka ịkụ ihe.
english: This soil is good for planting.

igbo: Ala kpọrọ nkụ anaghị enyere ihe ọkụkụ aka.
english: Dry soil does not help crops.

igbo: Mmiri ozuzo na-enyere ndị ọrụ ugbo aka.
Oké mmiri ozuzo nwere ike imebi ihe ubi.
Anwụ na-enyere ihe ọkụkụ aka ito.
Ọdachi na-emebi ubi.
Ọrịa nwere ike imerụ ihe ọkụkụ.
Onye ọrụ ugbo na-achọpụta ọrịa n'osisi.
english: The farmer detects disease in the plants.

igbo: Ha ji ọgwụ chebe ihe ọkụkụ.
english: They used chemicals to protect the crops.

igbo: Ọ dị mkpa ịchekwa mkpụrụ.
english: It is important to save seeds.

igbo: Onye ọrụ ugbo debere mkpụrụ n'ebe nchekwa.
english: The farmer stored the seeds in a safe place.

igbo: Ha na-echekwa ihe ubi n'ụlọ nkwakọba ihe.
english: They store the harvest in a warehouse.

igbo: Ụlọ nkwakọba ihe ahụ jupụtara n'ọka.
english: The warehouse is full of maize.

igbo: Ọrụ ugbo na-enye ọtụtụ mmadụ ọrụ.
english: Agriculture provides jobs for many people.

igbo: Ndị ọrụ ugbo na-enye obodo nri.
english: Farmers provide food for the community.

igbo: Ọtụtụ ezinụlọ na-adabere n'ọrụ ugbo.
Ọrụ ugbo bụ isi iyi nke ego.
english: Farming is a source of income.

igbo: Anyị kwesịrị ịkwado ndị ọrụ ugbo.
Gọọmenti nyere ndị ọrụ ugbo mkpụrụ.
Ha nwetara ngwá ọrụ ugbo ọhụrụ.
Traktọ na-enyere ndị ọrụ ugbo aka.
Onye ọrụ ugbo zụtara traktọ.
Traktọ ahụ na-akọ ala.
Ha ji igwe ewe ihe ubi.
english: They used a machine to harvest the crops.

igbo: Ngwá ọrụ kwesịrị ịdị mma.
english: Equipment should be in good condition.

igbo: Onye ọrụ ugbo rụziri igwe ya.
Ọzụzụ na-enyere ndị ọrụ ugbo aka.
Onye ọrụ ugbo gara ọzụzụ.
Ha mụtara ụzọ ọhụrụ e si akụ ihe.
english: They learned new methods of planting.

igbo: Ụzọ ọgbara ọhụrụ na-eme ka ọrụ ugbo dị mfe.
Ịkụ ihe n'ụzọ ziri ezi na-abawanye ihe ubi.
Ha na-akụ mkpụrụ n'ahịrị.
Onye ọrụ ugbo tụrụ oghere maka mkpụrụ.
english: The farmer measured holes for the seeds.

igbo: Ọrụ ugbo chọrọ ezigbo atụmatụ.
Anyị haziri ọrụ ubi nke ọma.
english: We organized the farm work well.

igbo: Ha malitere ịrụ ọrụ n'isi ụtụtụ.
english: They started working early in the morning.

igbo: Onye ọrụ ugbo laghachiri n'ụlọ mgbe anyanwụ dara.
english: The farmer returned home after sunset.

igbo: Ụmụaka nyere nne na nna ha aka n'ubi.
english: The children helped their parents on the farm.

igbo: Ezinụlọ ahụ na-arụ ọrụ ọnụ.
Ndị agbata obi nyere onye ọrụ ugbo aka.
Ha rụchara ọrụ ubi tupu mmiri amalite.
english: They finished the farm work before the rain started.

igbo: Onye ọrụ ugbo nwere ahụmahụ.
Ahụmahụ na-enyere onye ọrụ ugbo aka.
Ọrụ ugbo nwere ihe ịma aka.
Ndị ọrụ ugbo na-eche ihu mgbanwe ihu igwe.
Ụkọ mmiri na-emetụta ọrụ ugbo.
Ọ dị mkpa iji mmiri mee ihe nke ọma.
english: It is important to use water wisely.

igbo: Ha na-agba mmiri n'oge ọkọchị.
english: They irrigate during the dry season.

igbo: Ịgba mmiri na-enyere ihe ọkụkụ aka.
Onye ọrụ ugbo na-elekọta ubi ya kwa ụbọchị.
english: The farmer takes care of his farm every day.

igbo: Anyị na-atụ anya ezigbo owuwe ihe ubi.
Ọrụ ugbo na-enyere obodo aka ito eto.
Ndị ọrụ ugbo bụ akụkụ dị mkpa nke obodo.
english: Farmers are an important part of the community.
